purpose: Synthetic Discord dataset for the Mithril analytics prototype.

entities.members: Members and bots. Bots must be excluded from analytics.

rules: Do not hardcode dashboard metrics independently from these source events.
Derive Active Members from messages, reactions and voice participation.
Derive message metrics from member-generated messages only.
Replies are messages/interactions and should not be double-counted as a separate message source.
Retention uses the canonical 30-day definition from Mithril product documentation.
Activity tiers use the trailing 28-day window and the locked Activity Score model.
Relationships should be derived from member interactions using the meaningful-connection definition.
Trending conversations should emerge from interaction velocity/acceleration, not be manually flagged.

behavioralDesign.superusers: High-frequency, broad participation across multiple channels.
behavioralDesign.lurkers: Light detectable participation, generally low activity.
behavioralDesign.inactive: No qualifying activity during the 28-day activity window.
behavioralDesign.new: Recently joined members, with a subset activating within seven days.

suggestedImplementation: Use this dataset as the canonical source of truth. Compute page metrics from these entities rather than storing separate copies of metric totals.
